visible_lines: # What John must decide
ID: JNR-I8 | Version: 0.1 draft | Prepared: 4 November 2026
Proposed owner: John; Rhys checks Tolra facts. Approved by/date ____; effective date ____; next review ____.
Tolra supports JNR’s quality work. Software and documents cannot make a company certified. JNR is the company that gets audited. No company approval, audit or live validation is recorded here.
Use this sheet with John’s ISO adviser if needed. Choose what fits JNR’s real CNC machining and fabrication work. Blank means not decided. This sheet gives no approval by itself.
| Decision | In plain words | John’s decision | Decision date |
| Scope (4.3) | Which sites and work are covered? Does JNR do any design? Explain any requirement that does not apply; build-to-print alone is not the answer. | ____ | ____ |
| Policy and goals (5.2, 6.2) | What does JNR promise? What will it measure, improve and achieve by when? Choose targets and people to check them. | ____ | ____ |
| Procedure owners (5.3, 7.5) | Who owns, checks and approves each procedure? Who may inspect, release work, approve suppliers and accept a concession? Who covers absence? | ____ | ____ |

| Record retention (7.5.3) | Which records stay, where, for how long and from what start date? Agree customer/legal needs, access, backups and when deletion must be held. Ask the accountant/adviser where needed. | ____ | ____ |
| Remaining risk (6.1) | Which risks need action before use? Who acts and by when? What proof is enough to accept what remains? Do not sign away a failed required release check. | ____ | ____ |

| Audit readiness (9.2, 9.3) | Who can audit impartially? When will leaders review results? Are real records and completed actions enough to seek an external audit? What is still missing? | ____ | ____ |
For each open decision: action ____; named owner ____; due date ____; evidence/approved master location ____.

John approves JNR’s ways of working. An ISO adviser can help assess requirements; a certification body decides certification after auditing JNR. Rhys/operator separately proves technical readiness and recovery. This sheet does not replace their existing sign-off forms.
Source: [builder 5 handover, I7 draft #342](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/7a4529edc1844d9d792bf6467de8cf1b92c5990d/docs/iso9001/BUILDER-5-HANDOVER.md).

# Tolra evidence map for quality records
ID: JNR-I9 | Version: 0.1 draft | Prepared: 4 November 2026
Proposed owner: John; Rhys checks Tolra facts. Approved by/date ____; effective date ____; next review ____.
Tolra supports JNR’s quality work. Software and documents cannot make a company certified. JNR is the company that gets audited. No company approval, audit or live validation is recorded here.

**Present** means found in source, not proved in JNR’s installed system. **Partly / gap** names what people or another controlled record must supply. This is support for ISO 9001:2015 records, not proof that a clause is met. Clauses are signposts; use the licensed standard for requirements.
| Record / clauses | Real screen or file | Support and limit |

| Audit trail (7.5.3, 8.5.6) | [admin/activity](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/admin/activity/page.tsx); [admin/compliance](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/admin/compliance/page.tsx); [record Activity panel](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/components/activity-panel.tsx) | Present: filtered Activity and per-record history; Compliance shows the latest 25 audit entries. Partly: these views are not a complete audit export or an ISO internal audit. Coverage/integrity has defined limits; see [integrity proof test](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/tests/db/audit-integrity.test.ts), not a new pass here. |

| Document control (7.5) | [quote versions](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/quote-versions.ts); [worksheet/drawings](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/job-worksheet.ts) | Partly: quote revisions and worksheet/drawing controls exist. Gap: general policy/procedure approval, controlled-copy distribution and full retention workflow; use JNR’s controlled register. |

| User permissions (5.3, 7.5.3) | [admin/users](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/admin/users/page.tsx); [company roles](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/company-access.ts); [inspector authority](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/inspectors.ts) | Present: company roles and inspector authorisation history. Partly: John must justify access and competence; a role or tick is not evidence of skill. |

| Job/quote/order traceability (8.2, 8.5.2) | [quotes](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/quotes/page.tsx); [sales-orders](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/sales-orders/page.tsx); [jobs](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/jobs/page.tsx); [linked conversion/numbering](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/supabase/migrations/018_atomic_order_conversion.sql) | Present: quote/order/job links and numbers. Partly: records do not replace the customer’s requirement review or physical part labels. Sales orders must be enabled. |

| Material identity (8.5.2) | [material cert/heat fields](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/job-worksheet.ts); [job certificate pack](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/components/cert-pack.tsx) | Partly: saved fields/files help; JNR must match actual material and lot splits to finished parts and check the certificates. |

| Nonconforming output (8.7, 10.2) | [inspection/disposition](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/inspection.ts); [job Problem records](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/job-problems.ts) | Partly: inspection failures, rework/scrap/concession and problem notes exist when required database features are installed. Problem does not block Start/Finish. Gap: full cause/action/due-date/effectiveness log. |

| Complaints (8.2.1, 9.1.2) | No dedicated complaint workflow found in reviewed `app/`, `lib/` or `components/`. | Gap: ordinary notes/messages are not a controlled complaint log or satisfaction review. Keep a separate numbered record linked to the job, with response and follow-up. |

| Delivery evidence (8.5.4–8.6) | [delivery-notes](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/delivery-notes/page.tsx); [delivery print support](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/delivery-note-print.ts) | Present: job/customer/line details, status, recorded signature details, print/PDF and Activity. Partly: a note or marked signature alone is not proof of physical delivery or correct inspection. |

| Supplier/purchasing records (8.4) | [suppliers](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/suppliers/page.tsx); [purchase-orders](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/purchase-orders/page.tsx); [supplier status rules](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/supplier-status.ts) | Present: supplier records, purchase orders and Approved/Conditional/Blocked controls. Gap: full evaluation/review evidence. Existing/default Approved is not an assessment; Conditional warns, and unlisted supplier text has no status warning. |

| Exported copies (7.5.3, 9.1) | [list exports](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/export-records.ts); [year-end ZIP](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/year-end-export.tsx) | Present: selected/filtered list exports and issued-document pack. Partly: summaries do not include every attachment, history or quality record. Keep originals and check export scope/completeness. |

Keep JNR’s policy, training/calibration records, supplier assessments, complaint/action logs, internal audits and management-review minutes alongside these records. No complete Tolra workflow for these was established by this review. Blank templates and software history cannot replace completed company evidence.
Builder 5 / I9; claim `claims/I9`. Source/whitespace checks only; no live export or runtime test. Draft only; no merge, production SQL or feature build.
# Quality records: what to show or export for an auditor
ID: JNR-I10 | Version: 0.1 draft | Prepared: 4 November 2026
Proposed owner: John; Rhys checks Tolra facts. Approved by/date ____; effective date ____; next review ____.
Tolra supports JNR’s quality work. Software and documents cannot make a company certified. JNR is the company that gets audited. No company approval, audit or live validation is recorded here.
John agrees the sample with the auditor. Show JNR through an authorised staff account; do not grant admin access just for an audit. No export was run here.
- [ ] Record JNR company, installed version, review period, sample order/job IDs and preparer/date: ____.
- [ ] Agree private storage/sharing. Use the needed sample; protect staff/customer details and keep original records unchanged.
- [ ] Check each file opens, belongs to JNR and matches the screen. Record filters, selected rows, row count, version and any missing item. A filtered list is not the whole history.
| ISO clause | Show or export in Tolra | Add outside Tolra / gap |
| 4: context/scope | Follow a quote → order → job. | Approved scope, context, interested-party needs and process map; no full context export found. |

| 5: policy/roles | Admin > Users and authorised inspector scope/history; supervised viewing or permitted dated capture. No role-list export verified. | Approved policy, communicated duties and authority. Permissions alone do not prove leadership. |
| 6: planning | Relevant job/order change history. | Risks, objectives/results and approved changes; no full planning export found. |

| 7.1–7.4: resources/competence | Time pages, weekly print/export and inspector records; check scope. | Training/skills, gauges/calibration, resources and communication. Hours do not prove competence. |

| 7.5: document control | Quote versions, worksheet/drawings, per-record Activity; Admin > Activity filters. Compliance shows only the latest 25 entries. | Document register/approvals, retention and actual restore proof. No complete audit-log export verified. |

| 8.1–8.2: order review | Quotes CSV/Excel/Word/PDF lists, individual PDF; linked sales order and Job Board. | Customer order, drawing/revision, capacity review, acceptance and changes. Lists are not the whole contract file. |
| 8.3: design | No complete design-control export found. | Applicability decision; design review, verification/validation and changes if required. |

| 8.4: suppliers | Suppliers CSV/Excel plus status screen; linked purchase order/issued PDF. | Supplier assessment/scope/review, receipt checks and certificates; status alone is not approval evidence. |

| 8.5: production/traceability | Job Board CSV/Excel/Word/PDF, individual Print or selected Print Workshop Pack; drawings/certificate files separately. | Physical batch labels/splits, CNC program/setup, checks, supplied property and special-process evidence. |

| 8.6–8.7: release/wrong output | Inspection criteria/results/release/disposition and Problem records; Delivery Notes Download PDF/Print or Print Selected. | Release/concession authority, customer agreement, physical holds and rechecks. No full nonconformance export verified. |

| 9: evaluation | Saved hours, inspection and order samples for chosen measures. | Customer feedback, actual measures, impartial audits and review minutes/actions. Activity is not an internal audit. |
| 10: improvement | Related inspection, Problem and Activity records. | Numbered complaint/action log, cause, owner/due date and effectiveness/closure; no complete corrective-action workflow found. |

**Optional document bundle:** Settings > Year-end export > Download year-end export supplies period-based issued-document PDFs, `summary.csv`, `payments.csv` and explanatory files. Drafts are excluded. Read `README.txt` and `problems.txt`; unresolved records can lack PDFs/figures. This is not a complete quality-records or attachment archive.
- [ ] Keep an index: clause ____; sample ID ____; screen/output and filters ____; private file/reference ____; checked by/date ____; missing evidence/action owner ____.
- [ ] John checks gaps before the audit. Do not mark a missing record as passed, or click issue/send/approve/resolve merely to prepare evidence.

Source controls (pinned main): [quotes](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/quotes/page.tsx); [jobs](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/jobs/page.tsx); [suppliers](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/suppliers/page.tsx); [delivery-notes](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/delivery-notes/page.tsx); [admin/activity](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/app/%28dashboard%29/admin/activity/page.tsx); [year-end pack](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/year-end-export.tsx); [weekly hours export](https://github.com/rhyshume1997-alt/tolra-public/blob/68f89ca7b801a10587ff9b51d6c820462847b65a/lib/time-week-export.ts). The I9 evidence map adds feature limits. The installed release, permissions and available modules still need checking.
